name: pi-subagents
notes: Forked from nicobailon/pi-subagents. Capability contracts live in openspec (specs fleet-native-transcript and subagent-context-injection; the changes under openspec/changes/ for the rest); fork doc chapters live in docs/fork-extensions.md.

knownDebt.reason: ~72 pi-lens blocking findings across ~40 upstream-original files (no-unknown-returns, require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as, unchecked-throwing-call, error-swallowing) plus known false positives. By the 2026-09-17 decision the fork keeps upstream code byte-identical instead of adding per-site suppressions; re-checked on each sync.
Overrides intentionally stay broad: narrowing them re-enables ~11k anti-slop errors across ~436 upstream files that upstream never satisfied. Accepted debt.
The intentional broad overrides block adds a comma to the upstream closing brace; the single raw-vs-w line is that comma.

test:smoke:tool-activation fails locally: TypeError: SettingsManager.inMemory is not a function. The package devDependency aliases @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to the test shim (test/fixtures/pi-coding-agent-shim, 1.0.0 since the 2026-10-02 Pi 1.0.0 baseline), whose SettingsManager and DefaultResourceLoader are empty stubs, so this smoke script needs an environment where the real pi package resolves; it is not part of test:unit or test:all.

Upstream-original signature spawnRunner(cfg: object, ...) (upstream 649, and cfg: object at upstream 420) kept byte-identical per the 2026-09-17 decision: no per-site retyping or suppressions inside upstream files. Finding re-checked each sync.

resolveGlobalNpmRoot and 'terminates the owned npm process on timeout' flap under parallel full test:unit load (npm spawn + owned-kill timing); both pass solo and in single-file runs. Same family as the 2026-09-27 SIGTERM-on-spawnSync flakes, not tied to a fork change.

The spawn-family unit tests (nested-control.test.ts external-job follow-ups, background child-spawn timeouts, native fleet, subagent extension child mode) exceed their 10-40s waits under the default parallel `node --test` load on this WSL host — child processes start much slower than upstream CI and the suite grew with v0.74.0; every affected file passed solo and the whole unit suite passed with --test-concurrency=1 on that WSL baseline. Verify releases with the serial run, not the parallel one, on this machine.

Oxlint 1.80.0 reports two pre-existing no-runtime-typeof errors in runner-peer-preload.mjs:14 and scripts/build-package.mjs:72. Both guards predate v0.77 sync; preserving existing runtime guards and upstream byte discipline rather than adding lint suppressions. Rechecked 2026-10-10.

The 2026-10-10 execution host rejects Unix-domain server.listen with EPERM: eight existing Herdr unit assertions cannot reach their socket protocol. Keep production and assertions unchanged; rerun on a host allowing local Unix sockets. No test skips were added.

Three unit cases and one integration case assume each temporary cwd has no ancestor .git. The 2026-10-10 host mounts /tmp/.git, so unchanged resolveSequenceScope writes manifests under /tmp/.pi and shares sequence counters; direct createOrcaProgressTab confirmed that path and the second integration fixture receives title index 2 instead of 1. Both test files and production module are unchanged from pre-sync ffdfabd. Keep assertions/production unchanged and rerun on a clean temporary hierarchy.

The fork uses the root pnpm lock as its dependency contract. Its unconsumed package-local npm lock remains upstream-owned rather than tracking the independent fork name/version and Pi 1.0.0 SDK pins; regenerate mechanically if package-local npm installation becomes supported.

reapplyOnSync: v0.74.0 sync (2026-10-02): keep the fork's projectTrusted threading — upstream v0.74.0 added its own sessionProjectTrust(ctx)/projectTrusted fields and call sites for the same untrusted-project feature the fork already implements; on conflict keep the fork's currentProjectTrusted(input.ctx)/currentProjectTrusted(ctx) calls and trustedProjectCwd spreads, drop upstream's duplicate projectTrusted field declarations (async-execution.ts AsyncExecutionContext, child-launch.ts BuildInProcessChildLaunchInput, shared/types.ts) and duplicate object-literal properties (execution.ts, subagent-executor.ts at the executeAsyncSingle/runSync ctx sites)
